rubric_lines: RUBRIC legibility: pass. Two side-by-side linear panels, each titled with its device and unit ('titan P100 warm wall [ms]', 'H200 warm wall [ms]'); the left panel names all five stage rows and the right panel shares that y axis so the rows align horizontally. Every axis label, tick label and legend entry reads at native 1399x720 without magnification. One reading cost is recorded as non-blocking finding 1: the LU factor row occupies only about 11 px of the P100 panel (columns 392-403) and about 36 px of the H200 panel (columns 919-955), so the marks in that row are visible but their values cannot be read off the picture.

RUBRIC data_ink: pass. The content is five horizontal line-and-marker series on two axes and nothing else inside them. Measured on the render with a tight colour tolerance: 6101 px of base grey #929292, 1979 px of geometry blue #3478b5 and 5733 px of booking green #2e8b57; there is no shaded band, area fill, gradient or decorative mark inside either plot area.

RUBRIC decoration: pass. No gridlines are drawn; the top and right spines are absent, and only the two left spines at columns 391 and 918 and the shared bottom spine at row 618 are drawn; there is no background fill, panel frame, shadow or styled theme. The only furniture outside the plot areas is the legend and the axis text, both required to read the figure.

RUBRIC contrast: pass. All axis, tick and legend text is near-black on white. Of the marks, blue #3478b5 is about 4.7:1 on white, green #2e8b57 about 4.2:1 and grey #929292 about 3.1:1, all at or above the 3:1 graphics floor; series are additionally separated by marker shape (circle, square, diamond) and by the blue line's dash pattern, so colour alone does not carry the distinction.

RUBRIC table_form: pass. This is a grouped bar comparison of stage wall against device and configuration, which is what a bar chart shows better than a table; the exact per-stage numbers live in the evidence fragment's tables, so the image carries the at-a-glance comparison rather than tabulated data.

RUBRIC label_collision: pass. Nothing is clipped and no label overlaps another label or the data. The render's ink bounding box is rows 37-676 and columns 177-1358, and the outer 4-pixel frame carries zero non-white pixels on all four sides. No coloured mark reaches a plot edge: the furthest P100 mark ends at column 788 of a plot area ending near column 831, and the furthest H200 mark at column 1295 of a plot area ending near column 1356. The legend sits above both plot areas (their tops begin about row 104) and clears the canvas top edge.
